desc: Derive and implement the count \(q_i\) of marginal increments satisfying \(P_i(2j-1)\le T\), along with the corresponding cost \(P_iq_i^2\).
Implement an \(O(N)\) feasibility calculation for a threshold using sufficiently wide integer arithmetic and early termination when the cost exceeds \(M\).
Binary search for the largest feasible threshold using a safely obtained infeasible upper bound.
Prove that selecting all marginal costs up to the largest feasible threshold yields the maximum possible number of units, including tie handling.
Verify the implementation against both public samples.
